evidence.note: Wide drawer immediately left of the stove is fully closed.
A hand is pulling the drawer outward; it is partially open.
Drawer is clearly extended and its contents are visible.
Hand is pushing the still-open drawer inward.
Drawer is fully closed and flush with the cabinet.

events.object_description: Wide upper drawer in the lower cabinet immediately left of the stove

evidence.note: Both doors of the upper cabinet above the range are closed.
Hand reaches the first cabinet door at its lower edge.
The first, left-side cabinet door is open and the cabinet contents are exposed.
Both cabinet doors remain open.
The first door has been swung toward its closed position while the other door remains open.
The upper cabinet facade is fully closed.

events.object_description: First-opened (left-side) door of the two-door upper cabinet above the range

evidence.note: Only the first upper-cabinet door is open; the second door remains closed.
The user is repositioned at the cabinet and begins manipulating the second door.
Both upper-cabinet doors are visibly open.
The second, right-side door is still projecting outward after the first door has closed.
The second door is now closed and flush with the cabinet front.

events.object_description: Second-opened (right-side) door of the two-door upper cabinet above the range

evidence.note: Top drawer in the narrow cabinet to the right of the stove is closed.
Hand grasps the drawer handle and starts pulling.
Drawer is extended with utensils and boxed items visible.
Drawer remains fully open.
Hand pushes the drawer inward toward the cabinet.
Drawer is fully closed and flush.

events.object_description: Top utensil drawer in the lower cabinet immediately right of the stove

notes: Open is treated as the on state and closed as the off state. Four distinct movable parts are manipulated: two lower drawers and the two separate doors of the upper cabinet.
scene_description: A user moves around a compact galley kitchen and sequentially opens and closes a wide food-storage drawer, both doors of the upper cabinet above the range, and a utensil drawer on the opposite side of the stove.
